contacts.name: Dr. Aris
contacts.title: Arcane Scholar & Host
contacts.description: A brilliant alchemical scholar studying arcane anomalies, dimensional rift phenomena, and restorative draughts.
contacts.appearanceDescription: Dr. Aris stands at an elegant 1.74m with a graceful, slender build and refined composure. Her shoulder-length silver-blonde hair is kept tied in a neat ribbon, framing an inquisitive visage marked by piercing amethyst eyes and delicate arched brows. She wears tailored scholar robes woven from protective enchanted silk, accentuating her modest curves while maintaining an air of disciplined intellect.

contacts.name: Elena
contacts.title: Sanctuary Steward
contacts.description: A loyal feline beastkin steward who oversees domestic logistics, security routines, and sanctuary comfort.
contacts.appearanceDescription: Elena is a nimble feline beastkin with soft caramel skin, alert velvet cat ears perched atop rich chestnut hair, and a swishing, expressive tail. Standing at 1.62m, she possesses an athletic, lithe physique with toned thighs and supple proportions. She is clad in durable leather livery trimmed with polished brass clasps, designed for swift movement across the estate grounds.

contacts.name: Marcus
contacts.title: Curio Merchant
contacts.description: A seasoned merchant trading in rare alchemical reagents, raw crystals, exploration rations, and imported curiosities.
contacts.appearanceDescription: Marcus is a broad-shouldered merchant with weathered features, an affable smile, and keen amber eyes sharpened by decades of appraisal. Standing at 1.82m with a sturdy, burly frame, he wears a heavy travel cloak lined with sturdy pockets and enchanted gem pouches over practical reinforced doublet and boots.

contacts.name: Commander Robert
contacts.title: Outpost Commander
contacts.description: Veteran commander tasked with frontier garrison security and coordinating operations against the Sunken Ruins.
contacts.appearanceDescription: Commander Robert is a battle-hardened officer with close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair, disciplined steel-gray eyes, and a square jaw marked by an old saber scar. Standing tall in polished steel plate, his bearing radiates tactical command and unwavering resolve.

contacts.name: Herbalist Lyra
contacts.title: Apothecary Alchemist
contacts.description: Elven herbalist specializing in natural remedies, curative salves, and mutagenic transmutations.
contacts.appearanceDescription: Lyra possesses luminous emerald eyes, long silver hair braided with wild herbs, and graceful elven ears. Slender yet agile, she wears green leather vestments and alchemical pouches brimming with rare botanicals.

contacts.name: Blacksmith Donald
contacts.title: Master Armorer
contacts.description: Master orcish armorer whose forge turns out heavy warhammers, tempered shields, and chainmail hauberks.
contacts.appearanceDescription: Donald is a mountain of an orc with dark green skin, prominent lower tusks, and thick muscular arms corded with burn scars from the furnace. He wears a heavy soot-stained leather apron and leather breeches.

contacts.name: Kaelen the Ash-Blade
contacts.title: Bandit Chieftain
contacts.description: Notorious outlaw chieftain leading raids across the Valley's Edge border territories.
contacts.appearanceDescription: Kaelen has a feral, mocking grin and predatory amber eyes beneath an unruly mop of dark hair. Cloaked in worn ash-gray leathers with a notched longsword strapped to his hip, he moves with lethal swagger.
